title: Phase 2：序列關係挖掘第三個結果：132-避免排列 marked mesh pattern (0,0,k,0) 的 x 係數 g.f.，證明 A212339（Barker、Dale）與 A212341（Barker）的猜想；A212344、A212345 由 KRT Theorem 13 得到

A212339.proof: decomposition sigma = alpha n beta gives Q = 1 + t(P_k + x(Q-P_k))Q; x^1 coefficient G = t F^2 (F-P_k); k=3 equals Barker's g.f. and Dale's signature (exact polynomial identity). Brute force n <= 11, DP n < 60. No Lean.

A212341.proof: same theorem with k=4; exact identity with Barker's g.f.

A212344.proof: KRT arXiv:1201.6243 Theorem 13(1) with k=3: 5*C(n-3). Checked by brute force n <= 11.

A212345.proof: KRT Theorem 13(2) with k=3, a_3 = 9: 9*C(n-3). Checked by brute force n <= 11.

novelty.note: The x-coefficient formula is one extraction step from the KRT functional equation (exercise level), but KRT state they found no simple formula and OEIS marks the g.f.s as empirical/conjecture. A212344/A212345 are direct special cases of KRT Theorem 13. Not claimed as new. Reviewer: SUPPORTED_KNOWN for all four, because Barker's g.f.s are already in OEIS and KRT's closed form (17), also printed in the Mathematica lines of A212339/A212341, gives them by one differentiation in x at x=0.
